name: core
description: Stack-independent: working agreement, architecture principles (spec-driven, contract-first, Clean Architecture, DDD, TDD) and engineering principles for code (SOLID, DRY, KISS, YAGNI), delivery rule (feature branches, task PRs, tests first, review loop, merge policy), lead workflow (delivering-changes, shipping-feature-branch), review loop and branch review, debugging, grind-to-green, developer and reviewer subagents, project rules for subagents, session-start (with kit update in cloud sessions) and analyzer-on-edit hooks.
